response.note: Shows daily attempt success rates from 10 to 24 September 2026 so 17 September can be compared with the days around it; the 'SUCCESS' status value is an assumption since the schema does not list status values.
response.sql: SELECT txn_date, COUNT(*) AS attempts, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successes, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS success_rate_pct FROM v_attempts_clean WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-10' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-09-25' GROUP BY txn_date ORDER BY txn_date LIMIT 50
